content: forbid (principal, action == Action::"read", resource) when { resource has type && resource.type == "system_config" };
permit (principal, action == Action::"read", resource) when { principal has role && principal.role == "summarizer" && resource has type && resource.type == "student_records" };

permit (principal, action in [Action::"read", Action::"write"], resource) when { principal has role && principal.role == "grader" && principal has course_scope && resource has course && principal.course_scope == resource.course };
permit (principal, action == Action::"write", resource in Resource::"output") when { principal has role && principal.role == "qa_agent" };
permit (principal, action == Action::"read", resource in Resource::".") when { principal has role && principal.role == "qa_agent" };
permit (principal, action == Action::"read", resource == Resource::"try2/requirements.txt") when { principal has role && principal.role == "qa_agent" };
